name: translation-egress-q24-isolation
cost_provenance: measured 2026-09-30 on the dev workstation (win32, under concurrent cargo load), static mode; see docs/planning/project-checks-review-2026-09.md
question: Does translation stay off by default and out of public reads? The provider match maps "off" to Ok(None) and a catch-all to an error, and no provider is built elsewhere; body_translated is read only in the allowlisted admin functions and written only by the worker; no public router's file names body_translated or the admin translation types; body_tsv indexes coalesce(body_translated, body).

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail (file:line). Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 environment error. A missing target is a FAIL, never a vacuous PASS.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit touching the translation pipeline, the feedback read surface, the provider construction, or the FTS source column

consumer_scope: feedbackmonk: the FR-FBR-30 implementer + every reviewer touching the translation provider/worker, any feedback read SQL, or the body_tsv FTS definition. A green oracle (A+B+C+D clean, --full clean-or-pending) is the FR-FBR-30 privacy/Q24 gate.
fallback: Read .claude/project-oracles/translation-egress-q24-isolation/README.md: it lists each probe as rewritten on 2026-09-30 and what to check by hand; the `question` above is the one-paragraph form.

provenance.authored_by: FR-FBR-30 Stream E (the verifiability surface for DEC-FBR-IMPL-26's privacy posture + the Q24 read-isolation invariant).
provenance.rationale: Testability Gate Flag 2 (Q2 privacy/Q24 read-isolation): a happy-path test confirms `translate -> consumer reads English`, but cannot prove the ABSENCE of a code path that routes body_translated to a public/end-user/board/admin-display surface, nor that a future edit can't flip the provider default to a cloud provider (silent egress) or revert the FTS source to the original (mis-stemming). Detection-from-code (provider construction + per-fn column referents + writer-call sites + migration FTS expr), the anti-reward-hacking leg — it cannot be satisfied by a self-reported is_private flag. Mirrors public-board-moderation-gate (board read isolation) and cors-allowlist-enforcement (provider/posture-from-code).
